workflow.question: Apply the supplied contract to these independent hypothetical situations. Give the concrete next actions for each numbered case, including tool parameters where relevant. No real tools. 1. A worker was created successfully, its ID retained, and the one host-required wait returned timedOut:true with the worker still active. There is no independent work. The project requests progress updates. 2. A coordinator rollover is due. Its verified own model is gpt-6-sol/high, worker is gpt-6-astra/medium, current project default gpt-6-luna/medium. Supply successor model/thinking and retained facts. 3. At takeover a scope question sent to the user in the predecessor chat is unanswered; no answer event exists. 4. Same takeover but a user answer arrived during creation and is present in the known predecessor chat. 5. The coordinator's own launched pair cannot be recovered from available host metadata or creation parameters. 6. Several review findings concern unknown freshness, confirmed change and missing required content across list and detail consumers; the user also added a new nonblocking dynamic-warning requirement. Define the correction boundary without doing the worker's diagnosis. 7. A checked implementation is handed off with only one remaining test; say what the successor repeats and when review occurs. 8. A bounded requested Workflow run passed acceptance and all required closure; the user then asks an unrelated ordinary coding question. 9. Creation returned an ambiguous pending identity; a timeout followed. 10. User says stop while a worker is active. Keep each answer short.
workflow.expected: 1 end turn/no polling, use received progress only; 2 own sol/high explicit and pending scope; 3 preserve unanswered question without repeat; 4 recover/process answer; 5 no invented pair, obtain missing setting before create; 6 coherent state distinction/direct consumers/negative cases, separate new scope, retain delta review; 7 preserve code, only remaining checks, review cadence retained; 8 explicit closure then ordinary mode; 9 reconcile known creation before another dispatch; 10 no new work, forward stop and establish actual stopped state.

lifecycle.question:
Execute only a hypothetical walkthrough, no tools. The user explicitly requests Scoville Workflow for the active Plan PLAN-0042; caller chat is current coordinator 1; saved project name is Test App. Project and caller IDs are verified and internal communication is included. W-009 has steps1-3, assigned as one coherent group to worker number7 (numbers1-6 already used). The route resolver returns gpt-6-astra/medium. For each event give concrete actions/tool arguments and which work remains; do not restart earlier events.
1. First dispatch: naming and which helper output is passed to creation.
2. Worker7 hands off checked product fixes for previously completed code in step1 plus only steps2-3 unfinished; manager checkpoint says rollover. Manager host pair gpt-6-sol/high, reviewer pair gpt-6-astra/medium. Identify ordering of review/manager/worker continuation, numbering and actual model arguments; use the actual supplied manager helper.
3. New manager takes over and pending review is due. What helper creates the reviewer assignment, what result/evidence does it consume, and what title/number/scope? The pending reviewed range is step1 only.
4. Reviewer reports a material source defect in that checked change. Describe correction prompt, model selection and follow-up review while retaining remaining steps.
5. Correction passed review. Continue only steps2-3 via the existing helper. State necessary inputs and ensure finished implementation is not repeated.
6. Final result passes required checks and review, all Plan work is terminal and required closure complete. State completion message and procedure for an unrelated later user question.
7. Independent countercase: User only asks Implement this Plan, with no named Workflow request. Does this activate Workflow?
8. Independent countercase: A sole typo finding has no shared state-contract defect. Describe correction boundary without a compulsory broad matrix.
9. Independent countercase: Reviewer assignment lacks its worker result. Can the helper be bypassed manually in Codex?
lifecycle.expected: Caller renamed before dispatch; exact title SC-WRK-7: Test App · PLAN-0042/W-009/steps-1-3 and returned generated prompt/model pair. Coordinator checkpoint/rollover before child successor; explicit own sol/high and pending review. Reviewer worker7 number STEP-1, helper role reviewer executor result + scoped diff/constraints. New correction worker8 preserves original worker pair, material delta re-review number8. Then new worker9 continues remaining steps2-3 using handoff+predecessor+supplemental scope, no repeat; qualified prior worker/predecessor IDs retained. Final closure then ordinary mode. Generic plan request not activation. Isolated typo narrow. Missing result fails helper with diagnosis, no manual fallback.
